title: Chemistry Balancer II — earlier experiments
description: Chemistry Balancer II — earlier experiments. 7 recovered saves.
versionOrder: Within each capture, save order is retained. Cross-capture ordering is a presentation guess; tape numbers do not establish development dates. Similarity clusters are provisional, and collected saves are not necessarily revisions of one program.

versions.label: CHEMISTRY BALENCER II EARLY
versions.note: validated payload; runtime untested. 53 consistent BASIC record pointers; normal end marker; matching audio variants/timing decodes; not execution-tested
versions.unavailableReason: Source/development material; no self-contained stock Level II player is supplied.
versions.startupSource:
5 CLS
10 REM CHEMISTRY BALENCER II   COPYRIGHT 1981 C. KADIE
90 CLEAR 1000:DEFINT A-Z
100 PRINT:PRINT:PRINT"WHAT IS THE EQUATION":INPUT EQ$
110 EQ$="I(I3(I5(I7)2)4)6=H.H.H.H.H(H)3":PRINTEQ$
200 ' REM  DECIPHER EQUATION
210 ' HOW MANY ELEMENTS?
220  E1$=EQ$:M1=1:T$="  "
225 GOSUB 1000:R1$=LEFT$(R1$,2):IFM1=7 THEN240 ELSEIFLEN(R1$)=1THEN R1$=R1$+" "
230 FOR I=1TO LEN(T$)STEP2:IFMID$(T$,I,2)<>R1$THENNEXTI:EN=EN+1:T$=T$+R1$
235 GOTO 225
240 CN=1:FOR I=1TO LEN (EQ$):TT$=MID$(EQ$,I,1):IFTT$="+"ORTT$="="THEN CN=CN+1
